about_the_game:
Start a publishing company and become the biggest game publisher in the world!
From the garage to a huge office, with a lot of employees. Make decisions which games to invest in. Keep your employees happy and working, but keep an eye on your cash, as you are one bad game away from bankruptcy.

To make your employees happy, design the most efficient and comfortable office. You have a large selection of items to choose from, but beware not all items are evenly usefull.

Create your own marketing division, it is one of the most import divisions in your company. Choose how you are going to promote the games. Are you going for ads, billboards and other traditional methods or are you going for sponsort content and free demo's?

  • Furnish your office, with employees who can complain about sound or environment around there desk

  • Search for new game proposals, make matches you would like to play in genre and subject

  • Content for a long playtime, in-game content for more then 40 in game years

  • Detailed info about expenses, income and profit to make educated decisions

  • Hire new employees, but beware of there skills

  • Simulated intrest and economy, demand will depend on popularity of genre and subject

  • Organize playtests and help developers steer there game to succes!
